task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Using Amazon Braket FreeParameter, build a parametrized circuit RY(theta) on qubit 0 + CNOT, sweep theta over 7 points in [0, pi], and print <ZZ> for each value using shots=0 expectation results. The code must be a complete standalone script that can be executed directly and produces output.
